title: Parent categories are not shown after selecting the PARENT CATEGORIES tab on a category details screen

full_report.title: Parent categories are not shown after selecting the PARENT CATEGORIES tab on a category details screen
full_report.observed_behavior: On the category details screen for "Focus stacking images of insects," if the user taps the "PARENT CATEGORIES" tab, the parent categories of the current category are not displayed.
full_report.expected_behavior: The parent categories of the current category should be displayed.
